summary: Plain kerb on a busy road, homes about 13 m back, some cars parked.
reasons: Homes 13 m away on same side

best_section.where: West kerb of Indooroopilly Road, bend opposite the playing fields

drivers.seclusion: Nearest home about 13 m (detached at 51 m); open sports fields on the far side.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb beside a two-lane road, with a few cars parked on this side and the opposite verge.
drivers.traffic: Busy suburban road with a bus route.
drivers.convention: Some cars park here; a Bus Zone sign sits at the start, so keep clear of 0-20 m.

flags: Homes 11-16 m away along most of the stretch
Low-lying: about 5 m, Toowong Creek 99 m away
sun_shade: Tree canopy on both sides; sun mainly from the north and overhead.
